priorFailureCorrection.rootCause: The workflow supplied a parseable but non-canonical UTC validUntil instant without milliseconds.
priorFailureCorrection.correction: The workflow now supplies a canonical UTC instant ending in .000Z and emits bounded stage, status, error-code and error-message diagnostics without response payloads or secrets.

blocker.detail: The designated project-level Vercel automation bypass value available through the authenticated environment runner did not bypass Deployment Protection and redirected to Vercel SSO. Vercel did not permit the sensitive variable to be decrypted through its single-variable API.
blocker.boundary: No replacement bypass token was created because that action was explicitly prohibited. The canary stopped before database migration or lifecycle mutation.

securityIncident.response: The first ephemeral branch was immediately deleted, invalidating all of its credentials, and its temporary credential file was deleted. A fresh replacement branch was used for the later bounded attempt.
